statement.text:
Let S be a nonabelian finite simple group, and x a nonidentity automor-
phism of S. Let α(x) be the smallest number of conjugates of x in G = ⟨x, Inn S⟩
that generate G. The values of α(x) had been studied in (R. Guralnick, J. Saxl, J.
Algebra, 268, no. 2 (2003), 519–571).
   (a) (R. Guralnick, J. Saxl). Conjecture: If S is an exceptional group of Lie type,
then α(x) ⩽ 5 for every nonidentity automorphism x of S.
  (b) For each exceptional group S of Lie type, find the largest value of α(x).
                                                                              D. O. Revin
